invariants.rule: CPU1 SystemState is the sole top-level state-transition owner. ISR/DMA may report fault sources but must not transition SystemState directly.
A physical actuator or critical timing engine has one owner only.
Requested/commanded output state must never be treated as proof of physical applied state or ACK.
invariants.evidence: C28/M0 ownership contract; system_state.h applied/requested fields

invariants.rule: Browser/host transport expresses operator intent; it must not become the final OVP/OCP/OTP/PWM-trip/interlock safety authority.
invariants.derivation: Host admission is transport/domain intent while exact SystemState and C28/M0 contracts retain local/physical fault ownership.

invariants.rule: OUTPUT OFF must remain admissible at the HostCommandAdmission domain boundary even when OUTPUT ON is blocked.
M0 session invalidation clears upper output intent, requests OUT_ON=0, forces safe-off and stops live DDS without clearing active/latched protection evidence.
SPIB admission stays O(1): no DDS derive, trace, M0 transaction, physical output write, queue scan or blocking state-machine work on the response-deadline path.
Any null/pending engineering value must remain unavailable; never substitute zero, one, legacy values or a guessed datasheet value.
A test source file or historical statement is not a PASS claim. Qualification must bind result, toolchain/artifact and exact integrated SHA.
